doc_title_en: Notice of Expected Special Gain from Sale of Investment Securities, Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast, and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY8/12
doc_title_jp: 投資有価証券売却に伴う特別利益計上見込み及び通期業績予想の修正及び配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 投資有価証券売却益4,300百万円計上見込みと資本効率向上に伴う株主還元の充実

summary_en: FY8/12 dividend per share raised to ¥97.50 end (from ¥86.50), full-year ¥476.50 (stock-split adjusted). Interim dividend ¥390.00 announced. Increase driven by expected ¥4,300M special gain from investment securities sale and stock split effective FY8/12.
summary_jp: FY8/12期末配当を97円50銭（前86円50銭）に増配、通期476円50銭（分割調整前390円）。中間配当390円。投資有価証券売却による特別利益4,300百万円見込みと株式分割による。
tag_en: Dividend Hike - FY8/12 interim special: ¥97.50 end (¥86.50 prior), ¥476.50 total (stock split adjusted ¥390 interim)
tag_jp: 増配 - FY8/12期末：97円50銭（前回86円50銭）、通期476円50銭（株式分割調整前390円）
